description: The bar chart illustrates F1 Score performance (in percent) across multiple datasets for the MADLLM method and three ablated variants. The horizontal axis lists the categorical datasets in left-to-right order as SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI, with the axis label “Dataset.” The vertical axis is labeled “F1 Score (%)” and uses a linear scale spanning approximately 60 to 100, with regularly spaced tick marks at 60, 70, 80, 90, and 100. For each dataset, four adjacent bars are shown as a grouped set, corresponding to the legend: MADLLM (green), MADLLM w/o prompt pool (blue), MADLLM w/o feature embedding (purple), and MADLLM w/o skip embedding (brown). On SMD, the bars are approximately 93 (green), 92 (blue), 91 (purple), and 92 (brown). On PSM, the bars are about 97 (green), 77 (blue), 96 (purple), and 95 (brown). On SWaT, the bars are about 91 (green), 83 (blue), 90 (purple), and 85 (brown). On SMAP, the bars are about 93 (green), 69 (blue), 69 (purple), and 67 (brown). On MSL, the bars are about 87 (green), 69 (blue), 85 (purple), and 85 (brown). On WADI, the bars are about 74 (green), 64 (blue), 62 (purple), and 68 (brown). The grouped bars are not visually sorted by height within each group, and there are no special visual emphases such as outlines or annotations beyond the color legend.
